scenes.say: Rate these cafe crimes from one to ten. The last one is unforgivable.
A laptop on a four-top, all day? Six. Ordering while still on the phone? Eight. And snapping your fingers for the check? Ten. Unforgivable.

scenes.speaker: Dev
scenes.say: Somebody snapped at me once. Two years ago. I'm still not over it.

props.name: Dev
props.quote: Someone *snapped* at me. Still not over it.

scenes.say: What would you add? Rate it in the comments. Follow for more cafe life.
